jobs.description:
BAIN CAPITAL OVERVIEW

With approximately $215 billion of assets under management, Bain Capital is one of the world’s leading private investment firms. We create lasting impact for our investors, teams, businesses, and the communities in which we live. Over four decades we have strategically grown our platform to focus on Private Equity, Growth & Venture, Capital Solutions, Credit, and Real Assets. Today, our team includes 1,985+ employees in 24 offices on four continents. 

We partner differently to help people and companies embrace possibility and realize potential. Founded as a private partnership in 1984, we have fostered a culture of innovation, entrepreneurialism, and agility, empowering our people to define and own their career trajectories. Today, our partnership approach enables us to pursue strategic growth, build enduring relationships with a robust external network, and collaborate across our integrated platform to connect the deep and diverse expertise that unlocks breakthrough insights.

Our people are the heart of our advantage. Colleagues at all levels have a seat at the table as they tackle business challenges with a principal investor mindset. By asking incisive questions, respectfully challenging one another, and remaining intellectually agile, we work together to achieve exceptional outcomes. 

GENERAL PARTNER GROUP

The General Partner Group is responsible for the operational, accounting, tax, and reporting aspects of each of the general partner entities.  These entities invest across all of the firm’s business units giving the team the unique opportunity to gain exposure throughout the company.  Members of the team also regularly collaborate with several internal departments, including fund accounting, tax, legal, compliance, HR, corporate, and IT, as well as third-party service providers such as the firm’s tax advisors. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position would primarily be responsible for assisting with the treasury, accounting, tax and fair market value reporting functions for General Partner entities associated with the Private Equity, Venture, Crypto, Double Impact, Life Sciences, Tech Opportunities and Insurance business Units. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Operations and administrative activity of the partnerships, including cash management, capital calls, cash distributions, cash reconciliations, bank account openings and related regulatory requirements

  • Carry, vesting, and profit/loss allocations to the partners and members of the General Partner entities

  • Quarterly and annual fair market value reporting, including supporting documentation for capital accounts, trial balances and other financial reconciliations

  • Quarterly tax estimates and annual tax books and reporting for the partnerships

  • Cash, book and tax journal entries into Investran, the third party portfolio management and accounting software

In addition, this position will also:

  • Assist in generating responses to investor inquiries and requests for information

  • Create reports for GP investors including fair market value, tax basis activity, and partnership investment reports

  • Interact with other teams within Finance to determine appropriate treatment of transactions and investment earnings

  • Work with all levels from Associates to Partners on projects to enhance the performance of the team, department, and firm

  • Opportunities for additional responsibilities where performance allows

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1-2 years accounting experience in the financial service industry, with a solid understanding of investment partnerships preferred

  • Reliable and collaborative team member with strong sense of ownership and follow-through skills

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills; ability to effectively prioritize multiple projects with high attention to detail

  • Creative problem solving ability and sound judgment; ability to use own initiative and take responsibility for decisions and propose solutions

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with capacity to interact with all levels

  • Enjoys working in a service environment and understands the demands of a high paced, high quality firm

  • Ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion

  • Works well independently and capitalizes on opportunities to learn and grow

  • Advanced MS Office, particularly Excel

DESIRED BACKGROUND/EDUCATION

·Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

·Public accounting, partnership and/or financial services experience a plus, but not required

Compensation:

Expected Annual Base Salary $80,000 – 85,000

Actual base salary will be determined by a wide range of factors including but not limited to role, function, level, experience, qualifications and geographic location. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based upon factors such as individual impact, team and firm performance. Bain Capital offers a competitive benefits package designed to support employees’ health, financial security, family needs, and overall well-being.

Bain Capital is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst, Teachers’ Venture Growth
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are hiring a junior investment professional at the Investment Analyst level to join Teachers' Venture Growth (TVG), the venture and growth equity arm of Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP). Based in our San Francisco office, you will support North American direct investments across origination, due diligence, deal execution, and portfolio monitoring. It would be ideal to have the Analyst join in Q4.

OTPP manages US$200+ billion in net assets with a 9.2% annualized total-fund net return since inception in 1990, investing to deliver retirement income for 340,000 working members and pensioners. At Ontario Teachers', we don't just invest to make a return, we invest to shape a better future for the teachers we serve, the businesses we back, and the world we live in.

TVG is the division of OTPP focused on investing in high-growth technology companies. TVG's 30+ investors work from offices in San Francisco, Toronto, London, Singapore, and Mumbai, backing high-growth technology companies at the frontier of AI, enterprise software, climate/energy transition, and financial services. We focus on companies with established product-market fit, with initial commitments ranging from $50M–$250M of equity. Our portfolio includes SpaceX, Anthropic, Databricks, Canva, Gusto, and Epic Games — companies reshaping entire industries.

Who you’ll work with

You will report to a Director or Principal on TVG's North American direct investments team, based in our San Francisco office. You will work cross-functionally with investment professionals across TVG's global offices and partner closely with other teams across OTPP to ensure continued alignment with the organization's mission, vision, and values.

What you’ll do

  • Play a critical role across all stages of the investment process: origination, due diligence, deal execution, and portfolio monitoring

  • Develop investment theses and financial models including projections, sensitivity analysis, and valuations

  • Drive sector research to identify investment targets and perform competitive analysis

  • Prepare investment memos and present recommendations to internal committees

  • Build and maintain relationships with founders, investors, and service providers to support deal sourcing

  • Evaluate and monitor the ongoing portfolio company performance, and support ongoing strategic initiatives and reporting requirements

  • Represent TVG at industry conferences and annual meetings

What you’ll need

  • 1+ years of investment or deal experience (investment banking, private equity, VC, hedge fund, management consulting)

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

  • Strong financial modelling and quantitative analysis skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

  • Strong work ethic, team mindset, communication & presentation skills

  • Ability to work independently and thrive in a high-performance team environment

  • Genuine passion for disruptive technology and the startup ecosystem

  • Willingness to actively experiment with and adopt AI workflow tools as the technology and our practices evolve

The base salary range for this position ranges from USD $110,000 to $150,000.

This range represents the low and high end of Ontario Teachers’ salary range for this position and may be modified from time to time. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. The exact placement within the range will be determined by an assessment of the incumbent’s knowledge, skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role and to internal peers. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible to participate in Teachers' annual incentive plan.

What we’re offering

  • Numerous opportunities for professional growth and development

  • Comprehensive employer paid benefits coverage

  • A flexible work environment combining in office collaboration and remote working

  • Competitive time off

  • Our Flexible Travel Program gives you the option to work abroad in another region/country for up to a month each year

Job Title: Rates Structurer

Location: London

Corporate Title: Associate/VP

Join Deutsche Bank's Rates Structuring team in London, where you will work alongside Sales and Trading to deliver innovative derivative, structured note and financing solutions for institutional clients across EMEA, supporting a broad range of investment and risk management objectives.

As a Rates Structurer, you will help design, structure and execute transactions for insurance companies, pension funds, asset managers, banks, and other financial institutions, combining market expertise with a deep understanding of client objectives and constraints. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to structure and execute tailored solutions, contributing across the full transaction lifecycle from idea generation and analysis through to pricing, documentation and execution. You will also play a key role in developing new products and client solutions to help grow a market-leading rates franchise.

What we’ll offer you

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:  

  • Hybrid Working - we understand that employee expectations and preferences are changing. We have implemented a model that enables eligible employees to work remotely for a part of their working time and reach a working pattern that works for them
  • Competitive salary and non-contributory pension
  • 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to purchase additional days
  • Life Assurance and Private Healthcare for you and your family
  • A range of flexible benefits including Retail Discounts, a Bike4Work scheme and Gym benefits
  • The opportunity to support a wide ranging CSR programme + 2 days’ volunteering leave per year

Your key responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales, Trading and other stakeholders to evaluate, develop and execute client solutions across derivatives, structured notes and financing transactions
  • Prepare client materials, market analysis and transaction proposals to support client engagement and business development activities
  • Participate in client meetings, presentations and discussions, helping to communicate complex ideas and develop solutions tailored to client needs
  • Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and other infrastructure functions to facilitate transaction approval and execution processes
  • Contribute to strategic projects, product development initiatives and thematic opportunities across the rates franchise

Your skills and experience

  • Experience in a structuring role within an investment bank, with exposure to institutional clients
  • Strong technical and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate complex transactions and develop bespoke client solutions
  • Good understanding of financial markets, derivatives, market regulations and transaction documentation
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across clients and internal stakeholders
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
  • We value diversity and as an equal opportunities’ employer, we make reasonable adjustments for those with a disability such as the provision of assistive equipment if required (e.g. screen readers, assistive hearing devices, adapted keyboards)

About us

Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.

Deutsche Bank in the UK is proud to be named in The Times Top 50 Employers for Gender Equality and has been awarded a Gold Award from Stonewall and named in their Top 100 Employers.

If you have a disability, health condition, or require any adjustments during the application process, we encourage you to contact our Adjustments Concierge adjustmentsconcierge@db.com to discuss.

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - Prediction Markets
jobs.description:
Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies, and mathematical models.

Our Founding Partnersfirst conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, LondonSingapore.

What you’ll do as a Quantitative Researcher at Akuna:

Akuna's Prediction Markets team is looking to add a Quantitative Researcher focused on sports related contracts. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in developing Akuna’s sports pricing capabilities, working closely with development and trading teams to refine and deploy these models alongside our strategies. This position offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on an exciting new desk at Akuna. The ideal candidate will possess strong programming and analytical skills, a creative mindset, and a passion for sports. In this role you will: 

  • Design and develop data capture pipelines to enable the pricing of a variety of sports contracts (match outcomes, player props, in-game events)
  • Develop and calibrate pricing models using historical data in service of in-play quoting of sports contracts.
  • Build and maintain internal tooling to facilitate all aspects of the research pipeline
  • Work closely with trading and development to deploy models into production trading strategies, bridging the gap from research to production with an ownership mentality

Qualities that make great candidates:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in a technical field, such as Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics (or a related subject)
  • Proficient programming skills in Python (C++ is a plus)
  • 1+ years of experience in a quantitative or programming role, preferably within the trading sector.
  • Deep understanding of fields such as Linear Algebra, Numerical Methods, Statistics, Optimization, and Machine Learning
  • Strong interest in sports and quantitative modeling.

We are especially interested in high agency individuals who have practical experience in financial markets and see the recent rise in prediction markets as an opportunity to ply their trade to a new domain they find more dynamic and exciting: sports. If you are a working quant and a sports data nerd, we want to hear from you!

In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. We want everyone to feel empowered to apply. We welcome your application and encourage you to take the first steps toward your future with us!

In accordance with Illinois Equal Pay Act, the minimum base salary starts at $145,000. Exact compensation offered may vary based on many factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set. This role is also eligible for a discretionary performance bonus as part of the total compensation package and includes a comprehensive benefits package that may encompass employer-paid medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other benefits. The minimum base salary herein was determined in good faith by Akuna Capital LLC.

At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.

jobs.title: Capital Markets Analyst - Xtrackers/ ETFs
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Employer: DWS Group

Title: Capital Markets Analyst

Location: London

About DWS:

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.

Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.

We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.

As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

This is your chance to invest in your future.

Team / division overview

DWS Xtrackers covers a full range Exchange Traded Funds across Equity, Commodities and Fixed Income, as well as Segregated mandates, covering a wide range of index providers and array of benchmark types from multiple ESG flavours to Thematics.  DWS has an integrated investment platform with a strong footprint globally.

You’ll be joining the ETP Capital Markets team, which is responsible for managing primary and secondary market activities along with broker dealer relationships , as well as driving strategic initiatives and process improvements across other key external partners’ relationships.

Role Details:

As a Capital Markets Analyst you will (be):

  • Perform the day-to-day management of Xtrackers ETP primary market processes, focusing on operational efficiency, scalability, and continuous process improvement.

  • Identify and manage operational risks, ensuring robust governance, escalation, and resolution procedures.

  • Partner with internal stakeholders across Trading, Operations, Product, Portfolio Management, Legal, Compliance, and Sales to support new product launches, cross-listings, and platform developments.

  • Develop and enhance primary market mechanisms that support efficient creation and redemption activity, enabling tight spreads, strong liquidity, and depth in secondary markets.

  • Act as a Capital Markets Specialist within Xtrackers, providing strategic, operational, and market expertise to colleagues across Sales, Portfolio Management, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams.

  • Oversee and analyse secondary market activity across exchanges, including spreads, liquidity, trading volumes, market depth, premiums/discounts, and market maker performance.

  • Build and maintain relationships with authorised participants, market makers, broker-dealers, exchanges, and other market infrastructure providers to enhance primary and secondary market efficiency.

  • Engage with exchanges regarding market structure, trading platform requirements, market maker programmes, fees, and regulatory developments.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external clients, responding to technical product enquiries and supporting capital markets-related initiatives.

  • Produce market intelligence, competitor analysis, and trading analytics to support product development, business strategy, and client engagement.

  • Utilise high-frequency market data to develop and enhance analytical tools, reporting capabilities, and trading insights.

  • Maintain responsibility for the quality and accuracy of European Xtrackers ETP market data, ensuring robust, timely, and scalable data management processes.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Development, and external partners to maximise the value delivered to clients through market data, research, and analytics.

  • Support product development and delivery through analysis of competitor products, secondary market dynamics, broker requirements, and market structure considerations, including new product launches and listings.

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of the Xtrackers capital markets platform and broader business strategy.

We are looking for:

  • Experience within ETF/ETP Capital Markets, Delta One, Synthetic Products, Equity Derivatives, or a related trading environment.

  • Strong understanding of financial markets, exchange-traded products, and market structure.

  • Knowledge of Total Return Swaps (TRS), synthetic replication, and associated trading and operational processes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high degree of attention to detail.

  • Experience managing projects and coordinating multiple stakeholders across complex initiatives.

  • Strong risk awareness, with the ability to identify issues and implement effective controls and mitigation measures.

  • Advanced data analysis skills, including experience with Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools.

  • Experience using Bloomberg, Reuters, or equivalent market data platforms.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, clients, and external partners.

  • Self-motivated team player with a proactive approach to delivering results in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with ETF market makers, authorised participants, exchanges, or liquidity providers.

  • Knowledge of regulatory, operational, and trading considerations relevant to European ETF markets.

  • Fluency in an additional European language would be beneficial.

  • CFA Charterholder or CFA candidate would be beneficial.

  • Degree in Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or another quantitative discipline.

What we’ll offer you:

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves sand it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work - feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.

Some of our core benefits:

  • 30 days’ holiday + bank holidays, with the option to purchase additional days

  • A non-contributory pension scheme, up to 10%

  • Physical and Mental Health Well-Being benefits including (but not limited to) Private Medical Cover, a complimentary GP service and the support of Mental Health First Aiders

  • Family friendly benefits including generous parental leave packages (supporting all variations of family set-ups), to healthcare plans and travel insurance

  • The opportunity to support our CSR strategy which is focused on combatting climate change and achieving greater social justice. You can make donations to our partner organisations or take part in corporate volunteering opportunities in your local communities by providing on hand support.

DWS’ Hybrid Working model in the UK is designed to find the right balance between in-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Employees who wish to sign-up to our Hybrid Working model are required to work in the office two days a week, and given the flexibility to work from home for the remaining three.

Some business groups may need you to spend more time in the office, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.

If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.

We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this #ConnectingTheDots.

GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! 

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can!

What you will do:

PGIM Real Estate’s Originations team engages in all aspects of the loan origination process. As an Originator, you would be directly responsible for sourcing and originating commercial real estate debt investments for our various investors with a focus on Core Plus loans on transitional assets. The expectation is that this person will assume direct originations responsibilities upon joining. We seek demonstrated experience successfully originating and negotiating commercial real estate loans as evidenced by a strong track record of closed loans over the past several years.

What you can expect:

  • Responsible for sourcing (directly and through partnering internally) and originating commercial real estate debt investments across the United States for PGIM’s investors.
  • Responsible for managing all aspects of the loan origination process, including analysis, underwriting, debt structuring, pricing strategy, presentations to senior management, due diligence review, transaction negotiation and closing.
  • Developing relationships with prospective borrowers and intermediaries while maintaining and building enduring relationships with existing clients across PGIM’s platform.
  • Responsible for managing and developing a team of analysts and associates.

What you will bring:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in commercial real estate lending
  • Substantial knowledge of the transitional bridge lending space.
  • Substantial knowledge of the markets in Northern California and the Pacific Northwest.
  • Existing borrower and broker relationships in Northern California and the Pacific Northwest.
  • Familiarity with all major property types (multifamily, industrial, retail, office, self-storage).
  • A credit mindset and the ability to review, structure and underwrite loans to mitigate risks corresponding to the needs of PGIM’s investors.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as an integral member of a team.
  • Management experience.

What will set you apart:

  • MBA from a top program strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint) and Argus strongly preferred.

*PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

Note: Prudential is required by state-specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $215,000 to $230,000. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. Roles may also be eligible for additional compensation and/or benefits.

About PGIM Real Estate

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

Job Description

We have an outstanding benefits package which includes: 

  • Company-provided healthcare 

  • A competitive annual leave allowance 

  • Flexible working options, including hybrid working arrangements 

  • Generous pension provisions 

  • Income protection 

  • Health and wellness benefits

Your role:

As part of the Portfolio Construction and Engineering team, you will work alongside some of the best quantitative researchers and technologists to help evolve our investment capabilities.  You will be responsible for performing research, managing data, and developing APIs that will be used to power the investment process along with our flagship portfolio construction and analytics platform – Invesco Vision®. The role will allow for significant opportunities for creativity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities:  

  • Helping construct multi-asset and single asset portfolios using advanced asset allocation and portfolio construction techniques

  • Building high performance computing algorithms, infrastructure and APIs

  • Researching and building prediction and forecasting methods based on both classical statistical techniques as well as ML based techniques including Agentic workflows leveraging Generative AI

  • Some experience using third party risk models such as BarraOne or Axioma will be a plus

IMC is a global market maker, using advanced technology and sophisticated strategies to trade across major financial markets. With offices in Amsterdam, Chicago, and Sydney, we combine deep market expertise with cutting-edge systems to provide liquidity around the clock.

Our Equity Options desk is a fast-growing part of the business, trading a wide range of single stocks across the APAC region. We combine best-in-class execution, proprietary models, and high-quality market data to capture opportunities in both high-frequency and directional trading strategies. jobs.title: Market Structure Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to lead our Market Structure Strategy at IMC US, a cutting-edge quantitative trading firm. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in deepening relationships with key market participants and enhancing our market presence, while ensuring IMC stays ahead of the structural, technological, and regulatory shifts that shape our trading environment. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the strategic direction of the firm by influencing market structure evolution and collaborating with internal teams to ensure optimal trading and business outcomes.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Market Structure Strategy: Stay at the forefront of market structure changes across asset classes, providing insights into how regulatory, technological, and competitive developments impact the firm's trading operations and business.

  • Exchange Architecture & Technical Analysis: Maintain a technical understanding of exchange architecture and matching engine mechanics across relevant venues, and work with IMC experts to translate incoming changes—technological, structural, or procedural—into clear assessments of how they will impact IMC's trading operations, systems, and strategy.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with trading, technology, legal, and compliance teams to align business initiatives with regulatory requirements and market trends.

  • Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders, including exchanges, brokers, clearinghouses, and liquidity providers, to optimize trading conditions and market access. In addition to managing these relationships directly, collaborate with the right internal IMC experts to bring into key conversations, fostering stronger, more technically grounded relationships across the firm.

  • Competitive Analysis: Conduct ongoing analysis of emerging trends to identify opportunities for competitive differentiation and advantage.

  • Regulatory Advocacy: Work closely with legal and compliance teams regarding market structure advocacy; engage with regulatory bodies and industry groups to represent the firm's interests in shaping policy developments that impact market structure.

  • Business Development: Support identification of new business opportunities, including partnerships and expansion into new markets or asset classes, where they intersect with market structure strategy.

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • Industry Experience: 8+ years of experience in market structure, exchange technology, or strategy roles within financial services, ideally within a quantitative trading, proprietary trading, or market-making firm. Options market experience is critical.

  • Market Structure & Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of market structure across multiple asset classes (e.g., options, equities, futures, fixed income), including exchange architecture, matching engine mechanics, exchange mechanics, liquidity dynamics, and regulatory environments. Ability to quickly assess the technical and operational implications of exchange or infrastructure changes on IMC's business.

  • Proven Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence outcomes in complex, fast-paced environments.

  • Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret data and market trends to drive decision-making.

  • Organization & Prioritization: Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and prioritize based on IMC's top strategic priorities.

  • Relationship-Building: Proven track record of developing and maintaining strong relationships with key market participants, particularly in options trading. Skilled at knowing when to loop in the right internal subject-matter experts to deepen or extend those relationships.

  • Regulatory Acumen: Deep understanding of global financial regulations and how they impact market structure, trading, and compliance.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly to both internal teams and external stakeholders.

About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About the Role

Overview

This role supports both the research and portfolio management of our solutions portfolio management team. Responsibilities of the team include portfolio oversight, rebalancing, risk and performance analysis, as well as research into long term asset class expectations across public and private assets. The position requires a collaborative, detail-oriented professional capable of contributing across both portfolio management execution and investment research initiatives.

Portfolio Management

  • Serve as a reliable and flexible contributor to the WVB and wider solutions portfolio management teams, supporting high-priority initiatives and operational needs across the portfolio management agenda.
  • Develop deep expertise in discretionary solutions, including investment rationale, portfolio templates, constraints, and turnover considerations.
  • Support the strategic rebalance process through analysis, execution assistance, and operational coordination.
  • Strengthen position oversight, risk review, and performance monitoring capabilities across the solutions platform.

Research

  • Serve as a key contributor to the research and development of the framework underpinning strategic portfolio design in our public private multi asset products and solutions
  • Develop and enhance strategic assumptions related to private assets across the investment platform.
  • Conduct research and analysis to support the fundamental inputs used in capital market assumptions.

Skills

  • Early career, experience 3-5 years
  • Intellectual curiosity: the ability to ask good questions, problem solve, think entrepreneurially, develop new tools, and adapt to client challenges
  • Fiduciary Mindset: working responsibly and independently as part of a highly collaborative team focused on delivering best client outcomes. Engages in respectful debate and knows when to ask for help
  • Ideally multi-asset exposure
  • Evidence of quantitative skill (research, degree, portfolio construction, risk management)
  • Passion for technology, data analysis, risk, and portfolio construction: demonstrated ability to learn and use new technology and analyze and manipulate data.

Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems.

Our trading teams are each comprised of a dynamic group of traders, quantitative researchers, and engineers who work together to examine the global markets, seeking to understand the complexities of various traded products and exchanges. They leverage their impeccable statistical analysis and data mining skills, using the results of their research to make forecasts and develop profitable predictive trading models.

What You’ll Do: 

We build predictive models from massive datasets and develop algorithms to automatically execute trades in financial exchanges around the world. 

At Jump you will have the opportunity to contribute in a blend of three roles – quant researcher / data scientist, trader, and software developer – based on your incoming skills and background, interest and curiosity, and the new skills and industry knowledge that you will learn at Jump.

You will start by completing a training program focused on enhancing your knowledge of trading, programming, and quant research. The training consists of in-house courses and trading simulation developed and delivered by experienced quant researchers, traders, and developers. We have experts from around the firm who will teach you advanced skills in a variety of areas such as trading / market mechanics, statistics, python, C++, machine learning, and our research process.

You will then work alongside our trading teams to leverage our world-class compute environment to build predictive models and devise automated trading strategies across global markets.

Other duties as assigned or needed.

We are seeking the sharpest analytical minds from top undergraduate and graduate programs. No prior knowledge of finance or trading is necessary. We will give you the training that you need. 

Although we strongly value training in Computer Science and Mathematics, we are excited to meet people with exceptional achievements in any technical discipline. Recent hires include students from fields such as Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Physics, Operations Research, Neuroscience, Materials Science, and more.

If you have outstanding skills in math and programming and you are curious about the challenge of improving research with continuous feedback from competitive markets, we hope you’ll apply.  

Reliable and predictable availability required.

jobs.description:
Working Hours: This role requires working on shifts to support 24/7 coverage across regions

Role Overview

Squarepoint is building a Central Trading & Monitoring team to ensure around-the-clock supervision of trading activities and operational processes. As a Shift Trader, you will play a critical role in risk management, trade oversight, operational lifecycle management, and incident response. You will also actively contribute to the automation and efficiency of the team’s workflow by developing tools and scripts to streamline monitoring and trading operations.

Responsibilities

  • Active Risk Monitoring:
    • Monitor real-time exposures across Squarepoint’s trading activities
    • Proactively raise alerts and escalate incidents as required
    • Execute hedging actions following established procedures
    • Monitor profit and loss, and risk metrics, ensuring continuity during market holidays
  • Production Monitoring:
    • Oversee systematic trading strategies, including restarting as needed
    • Respond to alerts and ensure the smooth operation of trading processes
    • Support internal teams with issue escalation and resolution
  • Ad-hoc Trading & Operations Tasks:
    • Perform ad-hoc hedging and booking tasks as they arise
    • Support pilots and special initiatives
    • Respond to diverse requests from internal and external stakeholders

Additional oversight areas (as activity scales):

  • Monitor market-making activities and exposures, taking action in case of issues
  • Use and improve tools to run post-execution analysis and achieve best execution
  • Support trading of new products as they are launched (e.g., power and gas markets)
  • Oversee lifecycle management tasks, including monitoring of position rolls, option expirations, and corporate actions
  • Respond rapidly to risk limit breaches and serve as a contact point for market counterparties
  • Support near round-the-clock trading, including special coverage for weekend or holiday markets

Process Improvement:

  • Dedicate time to streamlining monitoring and booking workflows using scripting or automation
  • Engage with stakeholders to identify new requirements and extend team responsibilities

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or related field
  • Programming proficiency in Python. KDB is a plus.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate with teammates globally
  • Strong sense of urgency with the ability to work well in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
Job Description:

At Piper Sandler, we connect capital with opportunity to build a better future. 

We believe that diverse teams with unique backgrounds, skills and experiences yield more innovative solutions. This is reflected in our commitment to engage, hire, and retain bright, committed people to work in partnership within an inclusive environment that allows each person to achieve personal success and add value to our teams and communities.

We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented, and outgoing Junior Underwriter/Underwriting Assistant to support the California municipal underwriting desk. This role is designed for an individual interested in developing a strong foundation in municipal finance, primary market execution, credit review, and relationship-driven capital markets.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, highly organized, and possesses the confidence to advocate for market opinions, pricing recommendations, and transaction strategies. This role requires a professional who can build credibility with bankers, financial advisors, issuers, sales professionals, and investors.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Underwriting Desk Support: Assist the Senior Underwriter with daily market tracking, new issue execution, and transaction-related administrative tasks.
  • Market Advocacy & Communication: Develop the ability to clearly express market views, pricing opinions, and transaction recommendations. Act as a professional point of contact for bankers, analysts, sales professionals, and external market participants.
  • New Issue Execution: Assist with Ipreo-related responsibilities, proofing new issue wires, compiling allocation sheets, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure accurate execution.
  • Credit & Market Analysis: Prepare concise credit summaries for competing bond sales. Monitor daily market trends, investor demand, and pricing dynamics to support scale-writing and transaction positioning.
  • Banker & Analyst Coordination: Collaborate with banking analysts to gather market data for RFP responses and assist in preparing materials for client discussions and pricing updates.

Meeting & Schedule Requirements:

  • Early Morning Availability: Attendance at 5:00 a.m. PT underwriting calls, Monday through Thursday, at 50 California Street is required.
  • Weekly Calls: Participation in the Monday California banker call (8:30 a.m. PT) and the national banking call (9:00 a.m. PT).
  • Flexibility: Must maintain flexibility during active pricing periods and periods of elevated market activity.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Experience/Skills: 2 years of relevant experience is preferred. Strong interest in municipal finance and fixed income. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Attributes: Outgoing, confident, and persuasive communicator. High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks under time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Licensing: Series 52, Series 7, or other securities licenses are preferred but not required at the time of hire.

Development Opportunity:
This role provides direct exposure to the full municipal underwriting process. The successful candidate will work closely with the Senior Underwriter to develop the technical, analytical, and market judgment skills necessary for long-term growth within the firm. Over time, the candidate will be expected to form independent market views and represent the desk professionally in all internal and external interactions.

Our fixed income sales and trading team provides the full array of taxable and tax-exempt investment solutions with multi product trading desks across a 50-state distribution network. Clients gain access to a diverse range of expertise and product knowledge from the Piper Sandler national team of 200+ sales, trading and analytics professionals. Our disciplined approach emphasizes capital preservation, liquidity, and then yield. This approach serves as the foundation for the tactical and strategic investment decisions of our team. Learn more about our fixed income team here.

Piper Sandler values a strong culture dedicated to the emotional and physical well-being of our employees. Learn more about our commitment to our employee’s health, well-being, our benefits program and how we are here for our employees and their families today, tomorrow and beyond here.

The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $105,000 - $150,000 per year.  Placement within this range is dependent upon level of experience, location and other factors.  This position is eligible for annual incentive compensation which will be a part of the total compensation. Total compensation for this position will be competitive with the market.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran or status with regard to public assistance.

jobs.title: Analyst, Multi-Asset Portfolio Solutions (MAPS)
jobs.description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

The Analyst will join Multi-Asset Portfolio Solutions (MAPS) within Ares Strategic Partnerships (ASP). MAPS develops custom investment solutions for strategic and high-value institutional clients, including multi-asset portfolios, discretionary mandates and deployment strategies. The Analyst will support the design, evaluation and implementation of these solutions through cash-flow modeling, portfolio construction, scenario analysis and investment research. The role will require the translation of quantitative and qualitative analysis into clear portfolio recommendations and client-ready materials.

The Analyst will work closely with Ares investment teams, relationship management teams, investor relations teams, the Quantitative Research Group as well as the broader Ares Strategic Partnerships to develop and implement integrated solutions.

The role offers broad exposure across the Ares platform and requires strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, responsiveness and the ability to manage both longer-term analytical initiatives and time-sensitive client deliverables.

Primary Responsibilities

Portfolio Analytics and Solution Design

  • Build and maintain cash-flow, pacing, asset-allocation and portfolio-construction models for custom multi-asset portfolios.
  • Analyze portfolio exposures, deployment, liquidity, performance and risk under a range of scenarios.
  • Evaluate Ares strategies and investment opportunities based on expected returns, cash flows, fees, risk characteristics and portfolio fit.
  • Translate analysis into clear recommendations on strategy selection, allocation sizing and portfolio positioning.
  • Support the design of SMAs, fund-of-funds vehicles, co-investment programs, discretionary mandates and reference portfolios.
  • Partner with internal teams to apply scenario analysis, risk analytics and portfolio optimization tools to custom mandates and strategic client portfolios.
  • Collaborate with Ares investment teams across Credit, Private Equity, Infrastructure, Real Estate and Secondaries to develop integrated multi-asset solutions.

Client and Partnership Execution

  • Support the preparation of client proposals, portfolio reviews, investment committee materials and other client-ready analyses.
  • Coordinate inputs from investment teams, relationship teams and internal functional specialists.
  • Participate in selected client and internal meetings and manage analytical follow-up requests.
  • Support ongoing oversight of discretionary mandates and reference portfolios in partnership with internal teams.
  • Work with Portfolio Operations and functional partners to assess fund structures, leverage, capital flows, fees, tax, legal and operational considerations.

Platform Development

  • Build repeatable analytical processes, templates and reporting tools that improve quality, consistency, scalability and turnaround time.
  • Document methodologies, maintain appropriate data and model controls, and support automation of recurring analyses.
  • Contribute to internal education, knowledge sharing and thought-leadership materials, as appropriate.

Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in alternative investments, private markets investing, portfolio analytics, investment consulting, asset allocation, quantitative research, investment banking or a related field.
  • Foundational understanding of corporate finance, portfolio theory and capital markets, with demonstrated interest in private markets and alternative asset management.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with experience and comfort in using Python, SQL, R or similar programming tools
  • Demonstrated use or interest in using AI tools to systematize workflows and models would be a plus
  • Experience preparing client-ready analysis or supporting institutional client engagements is preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey quantitative insights to non-technical audiences.
  • Detail-oriented, collaborative, highly motivated and intellectually curious, with strong judgment and a commitment to continuous development.
  • Proactive problem solver comfortable navigating ambiguity and forming perspectives with incomplete information.
  • Ability to work effectively across teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable balancing longer-term analytical projects with near-term client deliverables.

Reporting Relationships

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$115,000 - $125,000

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more.

There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.

jobs.description:
Trillium is a leading proprietary trading firm active in US Equities, US Options, Canadian Equities, and OTC Equities. With trading technology built, tested, and optimized in-house, our engineers and technologists collaborate with our traders to deliver tools and functionality designed to support their needs. Our passion for the markets and our drive to succeed have propelled our track record of growth and profitability for over 20 years. At Trillium, we are a team of problem solvers and independent thinkers dedicated to seizing market opportunities.

We are headquartered in New York City, with additional trading floors in Chicago and Miami. To learn more about Trillium, visit www.trlm.com

The Role:

Trillium is looking for experienced, consistently profitable traders who are ready to scale their existing trading strategies.

This role is designed for traders with a proven track record, a defined trading process, and strong risk discipline. Applicants should be able to clearly explain how they make money, how they manage risk, and how their strategy can benefit from Trillium’s capital, technology, market access, and collaborative trading environment.

This is not an entry-level role, trainee program, or opportunity for candidates looking to break into trading. Candidates should not apply unless they have generated at least $1 million in cumulative trading P&L.

Compensation:

  • Monthly P&L-based bonuses (contingent on trading performance) 

Responsibilities:

  • Actively trade US, Canada, and OTC equities, as well as US options, identifying profitable opportunities in real time
  • Manage risk effectively by monitoring market conditions, adjusting strategies, sizing positions appropriately, and maintaining compliance with firm-wide policies
  • Maintain a disciplined trading process, including regular review of trades, market conditions, risk, and strategy performance
  • Follow macroeconomic events, company-specific news, market structure changes, and other research methods to inform trading decisions
  • Contribute to a collaborative trading culture by sharing market observations, trade ideas, and relevant strategy insights with other experienced traders

About You:

You are an experienced, motivated, and proactive trader looking to scale in a more sophisticated trading environment. The ideal candidate has:

  • A verifiable track record of trading profitability, including at least $1 million in cumulative trading P&L
  • At least 2 years of successful active trading experience in US equities or options
  • A clear, repeatable trading process
  • Strong risk management discipline
  • The ability to communicate trading strategies plainly and in detail
  • A competitive, adaptable, and resilient mindset
  • Please note, Trillium will not sponsor applicants for work visas

Job Requirements:

  • Must have a 2+ year track record of success in US Equities and be able to communicate your strategies plainly
  • Candidates should have meaningful live trading experience and an established process for identifying, sizing, managing, and reviewing trades

Benefits and Perks:

  • Medical & dental insurance options with FSA/HSA available

jobs.description:
About Cubist

Cubist Systematic Strategies, an affiliate of Point72, deploys systematic, computer-driven trading strategies across multiple liquid asset classes, including equities, futures and foreign exchange. The core of our effort is rigorous research into a wide range of market anomalies, fueled by our unparalleled access to a wide range of publicly available data sources.

Role

Quantitative researcher to help build out a systematic macro (futures, FX, and vol) strategies. Core focus will be working on mid-frequency alpha strategies.

Job Description

  • Develop systematic trading models across FX, commodities, fixed income, and equity markets
  • Alpha idea generation, backtesting, and implementation
  • Assist in building, maintenance, and continual improvement of production and trading environments
  • Evaluate new datasets for alpha potential
  • Improve existing strategies and portfolio optimization
  • Execution monitoring
  • Be a core contributor to growing the investment process and research infrastructure of the team

Desirable Candidates

  • Masters or PhD in mathematics, statistics, physics or other quantitative discipline. PhD in statistics or machine learning is a plus
  • Experience in quantitative trading, ideally in FX or futures
  • Experience with alpha research, portfolio construction and optimization
  • Experience building statistical/technical, fundamental, and data driven signals
  • Experience synthesizing predictive signals for both cross-sectional and time-series models
  • Strong experience with data exploration, dimension reduction, and feature engineering
  • Thorough understanding of and comfort using a variety of regression techniques—including OLS, MLS, Ridge, Lasso, and Bayesian inference—as well as techniques for dealing with errors that can occur, such as auto-correlation and heteroskedasticity
  • Experience managing and running risk is a strong plus
  • Proficiency in Python using the machine learning stack—numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, etc.
  • Creative mindset
  • Strong time management ability—the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • High degree of drive and energy—must be a self-starter
  • Ability to work cooperatively with all levels of staff and to thrive in a team-oriented environment
  • Commitment to the highest ethical standards and who act with professionalism and integrity at all times


The annual base salary range for this role is $150,000-$200,000 (USD) , which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. jobs.description:
About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About the Role

We are seeking an Equity Research Associate (RA) to join our Global Industry Research Healthcare Team. In this role, the RA will work closely with a senior Global Industry Analyst (GIA) to support coverage across the global MedTech, Tools and Diagnostics universe primarily in the US.
The ideal candidate will be a self-directed, intellectually curious team player with a strong interest in medical device, life sciences tools and diagnostics as well as broader health care investing. This role will require the ability to analyze financial, clinical, regulatory, reimbursement, market adoption and alternative data; evaluate product portfolios and competitive positioning; leverage AI to drive research efficiencies; and synthesize complex information to inform investment decisions.


Responsibilities for this position will include the following: 

  • Maintaining industry and comparative valuation models across medical device, diagnostics, and life science tools companies;

  • Building and maintaining company financial models with a focus on product-level forecasting, procedure volumes, pricing, reimbursement, margin trends, and adoption curves;

  • Assessing commercial opportunity, product differentiation, regulatory pathway, reimbursement dynamics, and adoption risk for new and existing medical technologies;

  • Analyzing clinical data, FDA and international regulatory developments, procedure and utilization trends, hospital and physician purchasing dynamics, and other industry datasets to evaluate company fundamentals and competitive dynamics;

  • Performing ongoing due diligence across the global MedTech, Tools, and Diagnostics landscape, identifying emerging investment opportunities and key risks across established and disruptive categories;

  • Executing complex analytical projects that leverage alternative data, AI, and other tools under tight time constraints; 

  • Staying abreast of relevant company, clinical, regulatory, reimbursement, and industry materials, including product launches, guideline changes, reimbursement updates, conference proceedings, and scientific publications;

  • Contributing to idea generation across both long and short investment opportunities. 

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

  • Analytical acumen and passion for markets –The ideal candidate will possess strong financial modeling skills and the ability to analyze clinical, commercial, regulatory, reimbursement, and financial datasets, while leveraging AI and data tools to drive deeper and more efficient research. Experience modeling product portfolios, procedure volumes, utilization trends, pricing, margins, and adoption curves is highly valued. Intellectual curiosity and a passion for understanding the drivers of MedTech, Tools and Diagnostics innovation are essential.

  • Judgment and investment focus – Successful candidates will demonstrate an ability to prioritize the most relevant information across a complex and fast-moving industry landscape and develop differentiated investment insights. A discerning analytical mindset and the ability to focus on the key drivers of value creation, including innovation cycles, competitive positioning, reimbursement, adoption, and execution, will be important.

  • Superior collaboration skills – The Research Associate will contribute meaningfully to the research efforts of the healthcare team while building strong working relationships across the firm. The ability to communicate investment views clearly, both verbally and in writing, and participate in a constructive investment dialogue is essential. 

  • Growth mindset – This role requires initiative, independence, and strong ownership of research responsibilities. The successful candidate will be proactive in identifying opportunities, deepening their expertise, and contributing to the team's investment process. 

 
QUALIFICATIONS
Additional qualifications and characteristics include: 

  • A minimum of 3 years of relevant investment experience; 

  • Prior experience in healthcare or MedTech, Tools or Diagnostics equity research, ideally in a buy-side or sell-side research associate role;

  • Experience analyzing medical device, diagnostics, or life science tools companies, including procedure volumes, utilization trends, industry datasets, clinical data, regulatory pathways, and reimbursement dynamics is preferred;

  • Financial modeling experience, including valuation frameworks for medical device, diagnostics, and tools healthcare companies;

  • Understanding of long/short investing concepts and risk management approaches is beneficial; 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities; 

  • High level of intellectual curiosity and willingness to engage deeply with clinical, technical, commercial, reimbursement, and financial material;

  • Strong data and technology skills, including experience using AI and tools to screen, rank, and analyze large stock universes; 

  • A willingness to lead effort to integrate AI into research processes; 

  • Sound judgment, strong work ethic, and the highest level of personal and professional integrity; 

  • Ability to work independently and make decisions in the face of uncertainty; 

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; and 

  • Superior academic credentials; an undergraduate degree is required. Scientific, engineering, biomedical engineering, healthcare, or related technical backgrounds are advantageous. Progress toward CFA/CAIA levels is additive.

jobs.title: Associate, U.S. Real Estate Equity
jobs.description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

Ares Real Estate Equity

Our real estate equity team, with over 310 investment professionals and over 385 operating professionals, has extensive real estate private equity experience globally. Our team primarily acquires standing assets and improves them through renovating, repositioning, and re-tenanting and selectively developing assets in supply-constrained markets. As of December 31, 2025, our real estate equity team managed approximately $90 billion of AUM in over 80 investment vehicles.

Strategies

Real Estate Core/Core-Plus: Our U.S. core/core-plus real estate strategy focuses on the acquisition of assets with strong long-term cash flow potential and durable tenancy diversified across end-user industries and geographies. We deploy capital across all major property types, with a strong focus on industrial and multifamily assets located in top-tier primary and regional distribution markets across the U.S.

Real Estate Value-Add: Our U.S. value-add real estate strategy focuses on undermanaged and underfunded income-producing assets across various property sectors in the U.S. The strategy seeks to create value and generate stable and growing distributions to investors by buying properties at attractive valuations, implementing asset management initiatives to increase income, and identifying multiple exit strategies upfront.

Real Estate Opportunistic: Our U.S. opportunistic real estate strategy capitalizes on increased investor demand for developed and stabilized assets by focusing on the repositioning of assets, capitalization of distressed and special situations, and risk-mitigated developments across all major property types, as well as select and adjacent sectors, across the U.S.

Position Summary

This position will be a key member of Ares’ real estate private equity team. The Associate will assist in assessing real estate investments for our diversified real estate investment funds, including the acquisition and development of industrial, multifamily, office, retail, hotel, and adjacent property sectors throughout key markets in the United States.

The Associate will be primarily responsible for underwriting and financially analyzing each opportunity, as well as performing property and market due diligence and playing an active role in the asset management and sale of the Fund’s investments. We are seeking someone who understands the importance of the technical skills relative to underwriting and asset analysis but will also eventually be able to take a front seat in sourcing new deals and building/maintaining relationships within the real estate industry across various markets.

Essential Duties

  • Create detailed and complex financial underwriting models for the acquisition and development of real estate investments across the risk spectrum

  • Perform asset-level and market-level due diligence

  • Develop thorough understanding of a deal’s capital structure and business plan and key risks to performance through discussions with sponsors, market participants and investment professionals.

  • Understand physical characteristics of properties, and the related competitive advantages and disadvantages

  • Understand and critically evaluate the existing and potential operating characteristics of a project (Revenue, expenses, capital expenditures, tenant credit, leases)

  • Identify a project’s demand drivers; gather market information through independent field work and direct contact with brokers, appraisers, and developers. Synthesize information and draw a conclusion on future market rent, absorption, vacancy, and liquidity in the investment market

  • Critically assess the execution ability of the development team for a project

  • Communicate conclusions into a comprehensive narrative to be presented to senior management for consideration and approval. Participate in Underwriting and Investment Committee discussions

  • Participate in and provide support for the ongoing asset management of each investment, including financing and refinancing, major asset-level decisions, and the eventual sale of each property.

  • Review legal documentation in concert with team and counsel throughout the negotiation process

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s Degree or international equivalent in Business, Finance, Real Estate, or related field with exceptional academic credentials

  • 2-4 years of finance experience. Previous experience in real estate investment banking or real estate private equity preferred

  • High level of expertise in Excel; ARGUS proficiency helpful but not required

  • Self-motivated and driven; ability to work effectively in a collegial, fast moving, demanding, and dynamic environment

  • Willingness and ability to travel required

  • Expertise in PowerPoint

  • Creative problem solver

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Attention to detail

  • Impeccable integrity and trustworthiness

Reporting Relationships

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$155,000.00 - $175,000.00

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more.

There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.
